title: get_registry

token_id.description: Registry token key (reg.tokens), shown after « · » next to the name in Tank's messages and results, e.g. bitcoin:BTC in «Bitcoin (BTC) · bitcoin:BTC».

entity_id.description: Registry entity key (reg.entities), shown after « · » next to the name in Tank's messages and results, e.g. uniswap in «Uniswap · uniswap».

name.description: Name or ticker of a project or token, e.g. «CoW Protocol» or «WLD». Tank resolves it like record_event (V3) and returns its registry rows; `name_identities` in the result lists the keys it resolved to, or UNRESOLVED:<name> when it is outside the registry. Null or omitted: no name filter.

description: Read fixed registry identity and dependency information: project names, aliases, contracts, official accounts and sources, plus registered causal dependencies. Filter by token_id, entity_id or name (a project or token by name or ticker; a name outside the registry matches nothing), or omit all for the whole registry. Registry links identify candidates; they do not alone prove a current integration, economic effect or token capture.
